# Country scope. Host binder helpers.
oe_nbe_bind_n = { save_scope_as = oe_nbe_tmp_n set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_host_n value = scope:oe_nbe_tmp_n } }
oe_nbe_bind_d = { save_scope_as = oe_nbe_tmp_d set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_host_d value = scope:oe_nbe_tmp_d } }

oe_nbe_bind_m = { save_scope_as = oe_nbe_tmp_m set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_host_m value = scope:oe_nbe_tmp_m } }

# Any scope. Resolve all 3 theater hosts safely (every location owner check preceded by has_owner = yes).
oe_nbe_resolve_hosts = {
    # Theater 1: Nordic / Baltic
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DAN c:DAN = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:DAN = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SWE c:SWE = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:SWE = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SCA c:SCA = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:SCA = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NOR c:NOR = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:NOR = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:LUB c:LUB = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:LUB = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HSA c:HSA = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:HSA = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SCA c:SCA = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:SCA = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DAN c:DAN = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:DAN = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SWE c:SWE = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:SWE = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NOR c:NOR = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:NOR = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:kobenhavn = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:kobenhavn = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:stockholm = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:stockholm = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_n = yes } } }

    # Theater 2: Danube Corridor
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:HUN = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BOH c:BOH = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:BOH = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:HAB = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:HUN = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:HUN = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:HAB = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BOH c:BOH = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:BOH = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:buda = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:buda = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:vienna = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:vienna = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:prague = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:prague = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_d = yes } } }

    # Theater 3A: Korea
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:KOR = { oe_nbe_bind_k = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:kaesong = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:kaesong = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_k = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:hanyang = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:hanyang = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_k = yes } } }

    # Theater 3B: Japan (verified EU5 1.4.9: JAP / ASK / NTC / STC / OUC / SMZ / HSK)
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:JAP c:JAP = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:JAP = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ASK c:ASK = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:ASK = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NTC c:NTC = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:NTC = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:STC c:STC = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:STC = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:OUC c:OUC = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:OUC = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SMZ c:SMZ = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:SMZ = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HSK c:HSK = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:HSK = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:JAP c:JAP = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:JAP = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ASK c:ASK = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:ASK = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NTC c:NTC = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:NTC = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:STC c:STC = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:STC = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:kyoto = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:kyoto = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:hakata = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:hakata = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_j = yes } } }

    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MCH c:MCH = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:MCH = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:JEC c:JEC = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:JEC = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HDA c:HDA = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:HDA = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ULA c:ULA = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:ULA = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YEH c:YEH = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:YEH = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ODO c:ODO = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:ODO = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SSH c:SSH = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:SSH = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SYG c:SYG = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:SYG = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:CHI = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MNG c:MNG = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } } c:MNG = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MCH c:MCH = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:MCH = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_nbe_yuan_restored = yes } c:CHI = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:JEC c:JEC = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:JEC = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HDA c:HDA = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:HDA = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ULA c:ULA = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:ULA = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SYG c:SYG = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:SYG = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:shenyang = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:shenyang = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } } }
    else_if = { limit = { location:hetu_ala = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } } location:hetu_ala = { owner = { oe_nbe_bind_m = yes } } }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization (1380+).
oe_nbe_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    oe_nbe_resolve_hosts = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_on value = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Expire closed windows & dispatch at most one event per calendar month across the 3 theaters.
oe_nbe_dispatch_events = {
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1450 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_1 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_1 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1535 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_2 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_2 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1670 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_3 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_3 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1545 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_4 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_4 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1550 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_5 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_5 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1695 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_6 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_6 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1565 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_7 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_7 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1585 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_8 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_8 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1675 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_9 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_9 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1670 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_10 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_fired_10 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_ev_m = global_var:oe_nbe_m } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_nbe_open_1 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_fired_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_ev_m value = global_var:oe_nbe_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_host_n global_var:oe_nbe_host_n = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no } }
                global_var:oe_nbe_host_n = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nbe.1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:DAN c:DAN = { is_rebel_country = no } }
                c:DAN = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nbe.1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_host_n country_exists = global_var:oe_nbe_host_n global_var:oe_nbe_host_n = { is_rebel_country = no } }
                global_var:oe_nbe_host_n = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nbe.1 }
            }
        }

            set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_ev_m value = global_var:oe_nbe_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt value = 1 } }

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 64 AND oe_nbe_pulse.txt fallback).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_nbe_ran_m.
oe_nbe_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_m value = oe_nbe_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_done }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_on current_year >= 1380 }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_ran_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_nbe_ran_m = global_var:oe_nbe_m } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_ran_m value = global_var:oe_nbe_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_init } }
            oe_nbe_init_line = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1705 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_end value = 3 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_done value = 2 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_nbe_on
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_nbe_sent_cnt
                    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_sent_cnt } global_var:oe_nbe_sent_cnt >= 10 }
                }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_end value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_done value = 1 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_nbe_on
            }
            else = {
                oe_nbe_resolve_hosts = yes
                oe_nbe_dispatch_events = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_kalmar_path value = 1 }

        add_prestige = 12
        oe_nbe_apply_kalmar_bond = yes
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_nbe_kalmar_centralized years = 35 mode = replace }

oe_nbe_test_start = {
    oe_nbe_test_clear = yes
    oe_nbe_resolve_hosts = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nbe_m value = oe_nbe_m_now }
}

oe_nbe_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_nbe_ran_m
    oe_nbe_monthly = yes
}

oe_nbe_test_nordic = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_on } } oe_nbe_test_start = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_n trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_n } var:oe_nbe_tst_n = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nbe_tst_n value = 2 }
        oe_nbe_test_me_2 = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_n trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_n } var:oe_nbe_tst_n = 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nbe_tst_n value = 0 }
        oe_nbe_test_me_3 = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_nbe_tst_n value = 1 }
        oe_nbe_test_me_1 = yes
    }
}

oe_nbe_test_danube = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_on } } oe_nbe_test_start = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_d trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nbe_tst_d } var:oe_nbe_tst_d = 1 } }
